items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I made several records with him.

ctx.x: No, but the ones that you made, but you never got a chance to see or hear or anything.

I've never had a chance to hear. Because I sing something in that number. You sing in that number? Yeah, I sing a couple of numbers. I don't remember. Because Frank and that, I think it was up on Maple Street where we made those records. Can you recall the way I'm talking about? At somebody's house? Yeah. Didn't Frank used to live on Maple Street or somewhere? They lived on Plum. Plum. That's a pleasant idea. Yeah, uh-huh. Plum or Maple, somewhere else. I think it was Plum. Almost a carol.

items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Frank Toast, he played with my daddy.

ctx.x: Frank Toast, he played with my daddy. And there was a fellow, they called him Pick, he used to play guitar with my daddy. And Selby Thomas, he was a bass player from the day. See, my daddy, my daddy was playing violin and he had this fellow Selby Thomas. And Selby Thomas, he was playing bass. And, oh, they had another other brother, he used to call him William Alonso. He was a trumpet player. But this little brother, he used to get to high all the time and my daddy, he just got disgusted. And that's when he began…
But he didn't go wrong with Tom Alvitt.

items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: they had, uh, this fellow Frank Toad, he used to be around by my daddy all the time.

ctx.x: No, it's true. You can't say that today.

No, you couldn't do that today. But, uh, they had, uh, this fellow Frank Toad, he used to be around by my daddy all the time. I used to come to my daddy's house and my daddy used to have rehearsal. That's why, uh, Punchfield's got to be so good. My dad used to call rehearsal twice a week. And, uh, well, they didn't, he didn't worry about Tom after rehearsing because, uh, when Tom would come over, my daddy would tell him, you know, what number they would rehearsal, this number, that number. And, uh, he'd sit…
How long did it take to get from New Orleans to the pass that way?
